The '''2017–18 [[Tahiti Ligue 1]]''' is the 71st season of top-flight [[Association football|football]] in [[Tahiti]]. [[A.S. Tefana|Tefana]] are the defending champions having won their fifth title last season. The season started on 15 September 2017 and finished on 19 May 2018.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2018.html French Polynesia 2017/18], RSSSF.com</ref>
